title: Seedance 2 character reference
description: Changes the person in your clip into the character in your picture, with Seedance 2 on Comfy Cloud. Give a clip, a character picture and what to change. Seedance bills by size and length; Comfy's node shows the price before a run.

requirements.name: LoadVideo
requirements.instructions: Comfy Cloud needs the core node LoadVideo.

requirements.name: LoadImage
requirements.instructions: Comfy Cloud needs the core node LoadImage.

requirements.name: ByteDance2ReferenceNodeV2
requirements.instructions: Comfy Cloud needs the Seedance 2 reference node.

requirements.name: SaveVideo
requirements.instructions: Comfy Cloud needs the core node SaveVideo.

evidence: 2026-10-27: graph from Comfy's own api_seedance2_0_r2v template, cut to one clip and one character picture. The node takes the clip as a reference video (2 to 15 s, 15 s in total with the picture) and the character as a reference picture, and is asked to change the person rather than to make a new clip. Comfy's price badge for this node is priced by size and length; it counts the price before a run.
Not yet run on Comfy Cloud: this task spent no credits. The graph and the node input names come from Comfy's template and the Seedance 2 reference node docs of 2026-10-27.

licenses.software: ComfyUI core (GPL-3.0) runs this graph on Comfy Cloud; the Seedance model itself is a paid service of ByteDance.
